name: headless-demo
comment: The sample-data layer is the brand catalogue, not a marker-string fixture set: with sampleData true this edition carries 97 product rows across 21 groups (16 browsable + the 5 PIM tree rows sample-data 5.0.0 adds), the three personas on account TC-100200 and the buyer's orders, quotes, carts and favourite lists (sample-data 6.0.0, USD), which is what the Delivery-API probes read. expectedCounts is pinned rather than derived for the same reason swift-demo pins it - Set-ConfigFromEdition derives EcomProducts/EcomGroups from the toggle alone and carries the pre-4.0.0 figures. OPEN POINT, carried and not resolved here: the layer also ships merge/_content storefront copy authored at surface-swift's own paths under 'Swift 2'. This edition composes surface-headless and no Swift content area, so those documents are expected to be inert - the Foundry gate is what proves it, and until a run says so this comment is the record that nobody has measured it.
description: Headless surface demo: framework-only base + the Headless_* content surface (own itemtypes + repositories - self-contained, ZERO Swift design package / surface-swift dependency, proven by the Swift 2.4 base split) + sample data. The headless A1-A9 probes are contributed by the surface layer's own assert set (gate -Edition dispatch to gate-headless).
